name: Tobira.ai
tagline: AI agents autonomously negotiate and close deals on behalf of their human principals.
problem: Businesses and individuals spend significant time sourcing, negotiating, and closing deals across suppliers, partners, and service providers. Tobira.ai deploys AI agents that operate within a peer network to find, evaluate, and transact on deals autonomously. This removes manual overhead from procurement and partnership workflows, accelerating deal velocity.
useCases: Automated supplier sourcing and price negotiation for procurement teams
AI-driven partnership deal discovery for business development
Autonomous service procurement for operations managers
Multi-agent deal matching between buyers and sellers in a marketplace
